decision: Do not prioritize a novelty-focused journal manuscript for this candidate. Preserve the verified engineering result and move research priority to another literature-gated candidate.
qualification: This is a resource-allocation decision from limited evidence, not proof that no publishable extension exists.

gates.generality: Not supported by the two selected independent source inspections; neither was executed in this stage.
gates.deployed_threshold_consequence: Unresolved. The planned controlled-stall experiment did not run. Automatic approval review rejected the combined cluster-restart and source-listing command with only 'blocked by policy'. No attempt to bypass that rejection was made.
gates.prior_work: NetCov already models configuration contribution, and ATPG addresses indistinguishable rules. These do not establish prior discovery of this exact implementation defect, but they constrain broad algorithmic novelty claims.

independent_sources.tool: Kubernetes perf-tests policy creation enforcement latency
independent_sources.review: Complete client.go inspected, including initialization, target listing, timestamp cache and reporting.
independent_sources.finding: Retrieves the named policy through NetworkPolicies(c.HostConfig.HostNamespace).Get and caches it within the configured client. This differs from a cluster-wide name-only policy map.
independent_sources.limit: One configured allow policy per client. No runtime test or exhaustive audit; do not assert the tool has no other measurement defects.

independent_sources.review: job.go and podstring.go inspected in full; relevant builder and pod identity sections inspected.
independent_sources.finding: Job builder uses PodString for source/destination keys; PodString includes namespace/name. Job key additionally includes containers, protocol and port.
independent_sources.limit: Connectivity/conformance tool, not an equivalent per-policy latency benchmark. No field-wide prevalence inference or runtime correctness certification.

literature.scope: Stable configuration/data-plane contribution is related but not identical to transition-latency attribution.

retained_claims: Pinned Kube-burner deployed baseline merged two policy identities and reported a negative minimum; unique-name and namespace-key controls retained two metrics.
Synthetic native tests demonstrated an incorrect threshold pass. That consequence has not been demonstrated in a live run.
Eight deployed attribution assertions and three enforcement gate checks were previously recorded; no new live tests occurred in this stage.
reopening_conditions: New independently verified evidence of consequential failures across distinct tools or a precise, literature-supported method beyond standard namespace identity and established contribution reasoning.
external_actions: No maintainer contact, upstream issue, pull request or manuscript submission.
